text: my RA and I independently coded the same 40 excerpts from our dementia caregiver interviews (people talking about shared calendars, reminder apps, location tracking, cameras in the house). one code per excerpt, 7 codes in the codebook. before we merge I need inter-rater reliability: cohen's kappa overall and per code, computed here not in SPSS, so we can see which codes we actually understand differently. then a list of the excerpts where we disagree so we can go through them together, my code next to hers.

ok we want to resolve them in here. for each disagreement pick A's code or B's code or a different one, with a short note on why, and it should remember the decisions if we close the tab. and some kind of progress, we've got 12 and one hour on thursday

the per-code numbers make it really obvious surveillance concern vs autonomy is the problem. can we edit the code definitions right there while looking at the disagreement? usually its the definition's fault not ours. keep the original wording visible so we can write up in the memo what changed
clicking a code in the agreement table should filter the queue to disagreements that involve that code. also keyboard pls: j/k to move through the queue, 1 = take A, 2 = take B
export for the methods appendix: final code for all 40 excerpts (agreed ones just keep the agreed code) as csv, and the codebook with old + new definitions and the kappas as json
